# أَسْتَعْظِمَ (ʔastaʕẓima) /ʔas.taʕ.ðˤi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْظَمَ (istaʕẓama)
# أُسْتَعْظَم
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
